---
title: "Data Storytelling"
subtitle: "Communicating analysis so decisions become easier"
---

This section is for work where the final product was a narrative, dashboard, presentation, or visual explanation.

## What I Emphasize

- audience-focused communication
- simple visuals with clear takeaways
- connecting charts to decisions
- balancing accuracy with clarity

## Recommended Page Structure

For each project in this section, explain:

1. who the audience was
2. what decision or insight mattered most
3. how you chose visuals or narrative structure
4. what action the audience could take afterward
